title: InsightsResourcesPaymentEvaluationPaymentDetails
description: Payment details attached to this payment evaluation.

amount.description: Amount intended to be collected by this payment. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal) (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a zero-decimal currency). The minimum amount is $0.50 US or [equivalent in charge currency](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#minimum-and-maximum-charge-amounts). The amount value supports up to eight digits (e.g., a value of 99999999 for a USD charge of $999,999.99).

currency.description: Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.

money_movement_details.description: Details about the payment's customer presence and type.

payment_method_details.description: Details about the payment method used for the payment.

shipping_details.description: Shipping details for the payment evaluation.
